author: Karen Kennedy
text: Every now and then, you'll apply a sensor to just the right spot and it hurts. Not the L3, specifically. The next one will probably be fine.

author: Linda Laidlaw Miller
text: Not really painful, but sometimes kind of achy

author: Gene Holcombe
text:
First you should never put pressure on the sensor especially when in bed. That’s what causes compression lows. You don’t want that!  Avoid laying in the sensor 
If you feel pain you may not have inserted it into fatty tissue. If too close to a vein or nerves it can cause that pain.
